added.summary: shooter.css dresses the shooter components' new parts: the vitals plate as the ammunition's cut glass plate (CombatHud.vitals), the keyline on both edges of the circle reticle's ring (Crosshair.ring), the magazine strip lit cyan on a hairline track (Ammo.magazine, Ammo.track), the weapon's name and the reload's words in condensed capitals (Ammo.weapon, Ammo.label, Ammo.prompt), and the killfeed's headshot mark in amber (Killfeed.headshot). The low magazine and the empty prompt keep --warn and --danger.
